body:
Implements ADR-012 (`docs/decisions/012-shorthand-expansion.md`).

## Background

Today, `p { margin: 10px 20px }` silently vanishes. `Stylesheet::parse` stores the raw multi-value string, `parse_px` rejects it, layout sees `0`. The same happens with `margin-top: 10px` written directly, because `fill_sides` reads only the shorthand name. Every contributor who writes normal CSS hits this and sees a browser that "doesn't do margins."

ADR-012 fixes this with two coordinated changes. No new files, no CMake changes.

## Scope

### Change 1 — Parse-time expansion (`src/renderer/css/stylesheet.cpp`)

Add an `expand_shorthand` helper in the anonymous namespace, called from `add_declaration`. For `margin`, `padding`, and `border-width`:

- 1 value  -> all four sides
- 2 values -> top/bottom = first, right/left = second
- 3 values -> top = 1st, right = 2nd, bottom = 3rd, left = 2nd (mirrors)
- 4 values -> top, right, bottom, left in order

Values are space-separated tokens. Each resulting longhand declaration inherits the parent `!important` flag. If there are more than 4 tokens or fewer than 1, skip the declaration (matches CSS error handling).

### Change 2 — Longhand consumption (`src/renderer/layout/layout.cpp`)

`fill_sides` reads `base-top`, `base-right`, `base-bottom`, `base-left` individually instead of the single `base` property. Same change for margin, padding, and border-width. The `fill_sides` helper gets a `property_base` argument (`"margin"`, `"padding"`, `"border"`), and constructs the four longhand names.

## Data model (unchanged)

- `Declaration { property, value, important }` — no changes
- `Rule`, `Stylesheet`, `ComputedStyle`, `LayoutBox` — no changes

## Behavior (from ADR-012's table)

Parse tests in `tests/test_stylesheet.cpp`:

- `p { margin: 10px }` -> 4 declarations, each `10px`
- `p { margin: 10px 20px }` -> top/bottom `10px`, right/left `20px`
- `p { margin: 10px 20px 30px }` -> top `10px`, right `20px`, bottom `30px`, left `20px`
- `p { margin: 10px 20px 30px 40px }` -> top `10px`, right `20px`, bottom `30px`, left `40px`
- `p { margin: 10px 20px 30px 40px 50px }` -> 0 declarations (too many values)
- `p { margin: 10px 20px !important }` -> 4 declarations, each `important = true`
- `p { margin-top: 10px }` -> unchanged (already longhand)
- `p { padding: 5px }` -> 4 declarations
- `p { border-width: 1px 2px }` -> 4 declarations, 1px top/bottom, 2px right/left

Layout tests in `tests/test_layout.cpp`:

- `p { margin: 10px 20px }` -> box offset from parent: top 10, right 20, bottom 10, left 20
- `p { padding: 5px }` -> content inset 5px on all four sides
- `p { border-width: 1px 2px 3px 4px }` -> four distinct border strips
- `p { margin-top: 10px }` -> top offset 10, others 0

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `expand_shorthand` helper in `stylesheet.cpp` (anonymous namespace)
- [ ] `add_declaration` calls `expand_shorthand`; longhands emitted into `Rule::declarations`
- [ ] `fill_sides` reads longhand properties from computed style
- [ ] All 9 parse cases above pass
- [ ] All 4 layout cases above pass
- [ ] `margin: 10px 20px` renders with correct top/bottom and left/right offsets
- [ ] `grep -rl "lexbor/" src/` still returns exactly `src/renderer/html/convert.cpp`
- [ ] CI green

## Deferred (per ADR-012)

- `border` shorthand, `border-color` (requires `LayoutBox` struct change)
- `background`, `font`, `overflow`, `list-style` shorthands
- `calc()`, `var()`, CSS-wide keywords
- `auto` margins
- Named border widths

## Two-commit plan

- **Commit 1 — parse-time expansion**: `expand_shorthand` helper in `stylesheet.cpp`, called from `add_declaration`. About 9 new parse tests. No layout change.
- **Commit 2 — longhand consumption**: `fill_sides` reads longhand properties, gets a `property_base` argument, calls four times with `margin`/`padding`/`border` bases. About 4 new layout tests.

Each commit independently reviewable; CI isolates any failure to a specific half.

## Refs

- ADR-012: `docs/decisions/012-shorthand-expansion.md`
- ADR-011: `docs/decisions/011-first-paint.md`
- ADR-010: `docs/decisions/010-cascade.md`
title: [Help Wanted]: Implement shorthand expansion per ADR-012
